What is Lectogo?

Lectogo is a network of charging stations with powerbanks that can be rented and brought along to charge their units on the go. Check the Lectogo app to find the nearest charging station on the map. Scan the station's QR code and rent a powerbank to charge your mobile, tablet or other devices. When fully charged, return the power bank to any station. 

How does Lectogo work?

1. Open the Lectogo app and find the nearest station

2. Scan the station's QR code to rent a powerbank.

3. Charge your device with the power bank (has all cables).

4. Return the power bank to any Lectogo station.

How do I pay?

After registering in the Lectogo app, you must register a payment method to rent a power bank. You add your payment card directly to the app,  then scan the station's QR code to hire, a powerbank "jumps" up as a toast and you can start charging! Price information can be found inside the app before and after charging.
